component.name: GNOME Stocks
component.summary: Real-time stock market monitoring widget for the GNOME desktop

description.p: GNOME Stocks is a desktop stock market monitoring widget that provides real-time price tracking, interactive TradingView charts, and AI-powered market intelligence. It supports global and Indian markets via yFinance, Finnhub, and Angel One SmartAPI data providers.

ul.li: Real-time stock price tracking with configurable watchlists
AI-powered market context and educational chat via Groq LLM
Support for US (NYSE/NASDAQ), Indian (NSE/BSE), and global markets
Lightweight GTK3 desktop widget with WebKit2 rendering

description.p: Initial release with real-time stock tracking, TradingView charts, and Groq AI chat.
